# VirtualTabs Documentation Index

> Compatibility endpoint for consumers that previously loaded a duplicated
> full-text documentation snapshot.

The old snapshot was removed because it drifted from the maintained source
documents. Use [llms.txt](https://winterdrive.github.io/vscode-virtual-tabs/llms.txt)
to discover the canonical documentation for each topic. Rules, commands,
counts, paths, and procedures are authoritative only in the linked source
documents.
